speech.quote: אמר רבי יוחנן אפילו קברו ברגל
speech.note: The ruling is expressly attributed to רבי יוחנן; its original recipient is unspecified.

speech.speaker: C
speech.quote: וכן אורי ליה ר' אלעזר לרבי פדת בריה אפילו קברו ברגל
speech.note: ר' אלעזר gives the same ruling to רבי פדת, described as his son.

relations.quote: וכן אורי ליה ר' אלעזר לרבי פדת בריה
relations.note: The possessive suffix in בריה refers to ר' אלעזר, the person giving the ruling to רבי פדת.
The verb describes a burial during the festival, with an unnamed subject and deceased object. These are generic figures in the ruling, not identified participants in the rabbis' exchange.

reading.story: On רבין's arrival, the text reports רבי יוחנן's ruling that the discussed rule applies even when burial occurred during the festival. ר' אלעזר gives the same ruling to רבי פדת, his son.
unclear: רבין's role as reporter is inferred from the formula; no audience or direct exchange with רבי יוחנן is specified.
The burial figures are unnamed, and the unvocalized קברו does not settle whether its subject is singular or plural.
The deceased person's relationship to the burier or mourners is unspecified.
The consequence of the ruling is supplied by the preceding discussion rather than restated in the passage.
